title: Domestic Pressure Cooker — Specification
notes: IS 2347 limits are not indexed by size/grade tables; most acceptance values are constant or expressed as a multiple of the manufacturer-declared (greatest) nominal cooking pressure (NCP). The only genuinely option-dependent values are the gross-capacity range (depends on heating type) and which lid-removal annex applies (depends on cooker/lid type). Table 1 (Scale of Sampling) is excluded by design.

parameters.specText: Gross capacity expressed only in complete or half litre units.
Tolerance on gross capacity = +499 ml, -0 ml (tested per Annex B).
Body capacity shall be more than 2/3 (0.667) of the gross nominal capacity (see Cl 4.2 / Annex B).

parameters.expected: No sign of leakage or deformation when air pressure of 40% of nominal cooking steam pressure is slowly raised to nominal cooking steam pressure.
Apply pressure not less than 2 × greatest nominal cooking pressure; no leakage or other forms of failure during or after the test.
PRD shall operate within ± 20% of the declared nominal cooking steam pressure (average of five readings).

parameters.parameterName: Pressure drop after PRD operation, Max
parameters.unit: % of average measured cooking steam pressure

parameters.parameterName: Destructible safety relief device functioning pressure
parameters.specText: Device shall function when steam reaches a gauge pressure between 1.25 and 3 times the greatest nominal cooking pressure.
Result of 5 samples shall be within a range of ± 20% of the mean value.
GRS shall function when steam reaches a gauge pressure between 1.25 and 2.5 times the greatest nominal cooking pressure.

parameters.parameterName: Resettable safety relief device functioning pressure
parameters.specText: Resettable device shall function between 1.25 and 3 times the greatest NCP; tested 25 times (type test, H-1.3.2).

parameters.parameterName: Temperature responsive SRD release pressure, Max
parameters.specText: Temperature responsive device shall release before a gauge pressure not greater than 3 kgf/cm2 (300 kN/m2 approx.).
Electric cooker thermal fuse shall function when steam reaches a gauge pressure between 1.25 and 3 times the greatest NCP.
Fusible plug shall melt/eject before a gauge pressure greater than 3 kgf/cm2 (300 kN/m2 approx.) is reached.

parameters.parameterName: Lead content in fusible plug pellet, Max

parameters.specText: Bursting pressure not less than 6 kgf/cm2; no incipient fracture or crack (separation of composite base acceptable).

Outer Lid.expected: Per Annex K: a force of 12 kgf (120 N) shall not release the lid/cover unless steam pressure inside has fallen below 0.18 kgf/cm2 (18 kN/m2) gauge.

Inner Lid.expected: Per Annex L: a force of 12 kgf (120 N) shall not release the lid/cover unless steam pressure inside has fallen below 0.18 kgf/cm2 (18 kN/m2) gauge.

Screw Clamp / Other Locking Device.expected: Per Annex T (Cl 8.6.3.1): a force of 12 kgf (120 N) applied to the opening device; lid/cover shall not open until steam pressure inside has fallen below 0.18 kgf/cm2 (18 kN/m2) gauge.

parameters.parameterName: Spring loaded mechanism permanent set, Max
parameters.specText: After 24 h compression then 3 000 compress/release cycles, spring permanent set shall not exceed 3% of length.

parameters.parameterName: Vent pipe minimum inside diameter, Min
Stainless steel rim thickness on glass lid, Min

parameters.expected: Indicator shall show that there is pressure inside the cooker (more than 0.04 kgf/cm2 or 4 kPa).

parameters.parameterName: Carbon (C), Max — stainless steel per Annex Q
Silicon (Si), Max — stainless steel per Annex Q
Manganese (Mn), Max — stainless steel per Annex Q
Sulphur (S) — stainless steel per Annex Q
Phosphorus (P), Max — stainless steel per Annex Q
Chromium (Cr) — stainless steel per Annex Q
Nickel (Ni) — stainless steel per Annex Q

parameters.specText: Not less than the minimum thickness declared by the manufacturer; thickness and adhesion tested per IS 9730, coating compliance per IS 9806.

parameters.expected: No blistering of coating during or on completion of 25 gas heat cycles (dry heat to 220 +5/-0 °C then quench in ambient water).
Non-stick coating shall conform to IS 9730.
Brass parts (except screws/studs/nuts) plated chromium over nickel; plating per service condition 2 of IS 1068 (adhesion and thickness); corrosion test (type test).

parameters.specText: Applicable only to hard anodized portions (Annex E).

parameters.expected: No staining visible on any surface intended to come in contact with food (tested per Annex N).
No loss of insulating properties of the coating on any food-contact surface (tested per Annex P).
Composite base/bottom SS cooker tested per IS 15960.

Per Annex M: dry heat to 250 +25/-0 °C and quench, 25 gas + 25 induction cycles (50 total); induction steel base shall not peel off/separate; 3-ply shall not show separation (delamination) nor blisters.
Per Annex R: heat to 250 +25/-0 °C and quench, repeated 50 cycles; body shall not show separation (delamination) of the 3 ply nor blisters.
Per Annex S: time to first PRD operation after test shall not be more than 25% greater than initial; cooker stable; induction plate shall not detach (else fails).

parameters.specText: Not less than 60 particles in a square of side 50 mm; count completed within 3 min of fracture.

parameters.expected: Smooth steel ball of 225 (+0/-5) g free-fall from minimum height of 1 000 mm on three points; no crack seen by naked eye under normal light.
Air-circulating oven at (120 ± 5) °C, soak 30 min, remove at ambient; lid shall not shatter (applicable for cooking-use glass lids; optional otherwise).
Drop lid from 900 mm onto vitrified tile/level concrete (with rim facing down, or without rim facing down); glass shall not break/crack.
Handles shall pass: resistance to burning, heat resistance, torque strength, bending strength, fatigue resistance, and thermal insulation tests per IS 13395 (at least once a year).
Hang a weight of three times the weight of the PRD (weight valve) for 4 h; no deformation or breakage of chain or its locating area.
Pressure cooker with integral electrical heating device shall conform to IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 15).
Body and lid free from wrinkles, scratches and other surface defects (checked with naked eye or corrected vision).
Body and lid neat and clean (checked with naked eye or corrected vision).

parameters.specText: Each cooker permanently marked on body with: (a) nominal cooking pressure (NCP), (b) gross capacity, (c) grade of material of body and lid, (d) batch number; lid marked with manufacturer name/trade-mark; BIS Standard Mark per IS 2347.
